in_sanskrit.name: आर्याण्श
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Aryansh' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'आर्य' (arya) meaning noble and 'आन् (an) meaning son. Thus, Aryansh can be translated to 'nobleman's son'.

in_hindi.name: अर्यांश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Aryansh' in Hindi is derived from the Persian words 'शही (shahi)' meaning king and 'ज़द (zad)' meaning son. Thus, Aryansh can be translated to 'king's son'. Note that this etymology is not related to the Sanskrit etymology but is a common usage in Hindi.

in_tamil.name: அர்யன்ஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name 'Aryansh' in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit words 'அரியன் (ariyan)' meaning noble and 'ஆழ்வர் (aravar)' meaning man. Thus, Aryansh can be translated to 'nobleman'.

in_telugu.name: అర్యన్ష
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name 'Aryansh' in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'అర్యదేశ్ (aryadhesham)' meaning noble and 'శీయేణ్ (sheyenam)' meaning lord. Thus, Aryansh can be translated to 'lord of the nobles'.

in_marathi.name: Aryansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Noble, Ancient, King
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aryan (noble) + Sh (god of the sun, or Lord Shiva)
